bodyHtml:
📩 Google Workspace & Microsoft 365 · Logan & Surrounds

Google Workspace & Office 365 Setup Logan. Seamless Email Migration, Zero Hassle.

Tired of outdated email systems or unreliable webmail? Computer Repairs Logan helps individuals and businesses migrate their emails to modern platforms like Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, with zero hassle and minimal downtime.

Set Up My Workspace
✓ No Data Loss
✓ Minimal Downtime
✓ Encrypted Transfers
✓ Staff Training Included
Why It Matters

Tired Of Outdated Email Or Unreliable Webmail?

Cloud-based platforms like Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 offer faster performance, anywhere-access from any device, massive mailbox storage, built-in security and anti-spam protection, and seamless integration with productivity tools like Docs, Sheets, Excel and Teams.

Our Approach

Zero Hassle, Minimal Downtime.

Computer Repairs Logan helps individuals and businesses migrate their emails to modern platforms like Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, with zero hassle and minimal downtime, and no data loss.

What's Included

A Step-By-Step Migration Plan.

🔎

Pre-Migration Audit

A full audit of your current email system before we touch anything, tailored to your business size and platform.

🔄

Migration To Your Chosen Platform

Migration to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or your preferred provider, with a backup of all emails, contacts and calendars first.

🧪

Post-Migration Testing

We test everything before we call the job done, with optional staff training and support included.

🔐

Data Integrity & Security

No data loss, minimal (or zero, where possible) downtime, encrypted transfers, and admin setup with DNS changes and SPF/DKIM configured for deliverability.

📚

We Migrate From Almost Anything

cPanel/webmail, personal Gmail, Outlook desktop or Exchange, Hotmail/Yahoo/BigPond/older ISP emails, and other third-party hosted mail.

📅

Shared Calendars & Mobile Setup

Shared calendars and delegated access for teams, plus mobile device configuration on iOS, Android and tablets.

Additional Services

Beyond A Standard Migration.

  • Legacy email backup. PST/EML/MBOX conversions, full export and archiving of old accounts even if they're not being migrated.
  • Split-domain migration. Useful if you want to migrate only some users while keeping others on the old system temporarily.
  • Staged migrations. Moving departments or mailboxes in phases to reduce disruption for larger teams.
  • DNS configuration. Full setup of MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records for better deliverability and security.
Why Choose Computer Repairs Logan

Technicians Who Understand Both Tech And Business.

  • No cookie-cutter solutions. Every migration is personalised to your platform, devices and daily usage.
  • Local support & training. No call centres, no confusion, just help that works.
  • Privacy-focused setups. Configured to keep your email safe, secure and compliant.
  • Stays intact, and better. Your business or personal workflow keeps working, without the old headaches.
Related Services

Pair Your Migration With The Rest Of Your Setup.

Need a business domain and matching email address first? See domain & custom email setup. Want your files properly backed up alongside your new cloud email? Check our data backup & transfer and cloud backup / storage services. Locking down a new Workspace or 365 account properly also pairs well with our password manager & 2FA setup service.

Frequently Asked Questions

Your Questions, Answered.

Can you migrate emails from third-party clients like Zimbra or Zoho Mail?

Yes, we support migrations from platforms like Zimbra and Zoho Mail to ensure a seamless transition to your chosen provider.

How do you ensure data integrity during the migration process?

We use secure transfer protocols and verification methods to preserve all your emails, attachments and metadata accurately.

Is it possible to migrate email archives and PST files?

Yes, we import archived emails and PST files so you retain full access to your historical communications.

What measures are in place to prevent email downtime during migration?

We use staged migrations and coexistence models to maintain business continuity and avoid interruptions.

Is training provided for staff to adapt to the new email platform?

Yes, we offer staff onboarding and usage training to maximise productivity and reduce confusion after the switch.

What's the typical timeline for an email migration?

Most small businesses can expect 1 to 3 days. Larger or more complex jobs may take a week or more.

Ready To Upgrade Your Email Experience?

Get a free email review and a custom migration plan for your business.

Set Up My Workspace
